priorityList: Use Black Arrow as your top priority whenever available.
Use Trueshot on cooldown, ideally when you are not currently under the effect of Double Tap.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Unload talent triggers a Kill Shot proc, especially if the target is below 20% health or Bulletstorm stacks are low.
Spend Precise Shots stacks on Arcane Shot.
Cast Volley on cooldown to enable Trick Shots synergy.
Cast Aimed Shot while the Trick Shots buff from Volley is active and Trueshot is not active.
Cast Aimed Shot to prevent charges from capping at 2.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown to generate Focus and maintain the Bulletstorm buff.
Cast Arcane Shot as a Focus spender to avoid capping your Focus pool.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler when all other abilities are on cooldown and you need Focus.
Use offensive racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) and Combat Potions while Trueshot is active.
Use on-use Trinkets during Trueshot, especially if the trinket's duration aligns with your Trueshot window.
